summary.zh: 修复登出后被立即弹回主页的问题：登录成功信号改为一次性消费，登出后稳定停留在登录页。
summary.en: Fixed being bounced back to Home right after sign-out: the login-success signal is now consumed once, so the app stays on the login page after signing out.

items.zh: 修复退出登录后未停留登录页、被自动弹回主页的问题
items.en: Fixed the app bouncing back to Home instead of staying on the login page after sign-out

items.zh: 登录页按钮文案调整为「GitHub 授权登录」，并移除上一版的诊断提示
items.en: Login button copy updated to “Authorize with GitHub”; diagnostic traces removed
